4125-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4125-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4518-7646--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Krallenhorde Howler.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-7646--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-4314-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

5900-7818-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-7818-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

643-5310-6879-8095.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5310-6879-8095.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

586-3899-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5231-7084-7893.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2073-2981-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2981-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
676-3259-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1939-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1322-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-4184-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Relentless Skaabs enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Relentless Skaabs enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-4184-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

640-7275-7510.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-7275-7510.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hancock.
Hancock dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Hancock trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Hancock, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

500-2081-7487.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Zealous Lorecaster and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

573-1558-2638-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-2638-4231-4365.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4907-6747-6797-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-6747-6797-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2034-3169-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
2034-3169-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

176-2511-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2511-6705.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

5448-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5448-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3750-7017-7024.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Zuko.
You have at least five experience counters.
3750-7017-7024.description:
Declare Zuko as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of experience counters you have.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Upwelling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2173-3558-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6705-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insect and Frog by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2038-4013-6753.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

222-413-2060-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-413-2060-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature enter the battlefield, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once, and Blasting Station triggers for each creature that entered.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities, untapping it.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers.
Holding priority, if you returned another creature in step 1, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing that creature. If you did not, skip to step 9.
When that creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 5, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 10.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-413-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1308-3951-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1308-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1283-3918-4222.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
1283-3918-4222.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

5276-5332-5686-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-2060-2438-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-2438-5544-6431.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

184-736-4682.notablePrerequisites:
Copy Enchantment on the battlefield as a copy of Smothering Tithe
You have at least two opponents which are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-736-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe and Copy Enchantment trigger for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

710-4050-4775.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

64-372-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

891-2523-5231-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2523-5231-5515.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {R}.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Repeat.

282-734-4705-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-734-4705-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering Delina twice and Lightning Runner once.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Bristling Hydra that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Bristling Hydra token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

157-372-1938.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
157-372-1938.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Detention Sphere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Detention Sphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glorious Protector.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Detention Sphere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Detention Sphere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-3375-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

751-3263-3841-4659.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake for {1}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Human Soldier token, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1267-2382-3745.notablePrerequisites: Opponents can not block Medomai token.
1267-2382-3745.description:
Pay {3} and tap Mimic Vat to create a copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Attack with the Identity Thief token, triggering it and exiling Medomai the Ageless until end of turn.
the Identity Thief token will deal combat damage as a copy of Medomai the Ageless, granting you an extra turn.
At the end of the turn, Medomai the Ageless returns to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the token.
Repeat for infinite turns.
